plans.idea: Keep the original's left-product / right-message split: the bottle sits large in the left column over the peach circle, and the headline, copy, badges and CTA share one left edge in the right column, with the legal line running full width along the bottom.

Headline-first editorial layout: a full-width headline and subhead band across the top, then a lower half with badges stacked over the CTA on the left and a large bottle on the right, so the eye reads message, then proof, then action, with the product beside them.

Product-led vertical poster: a big centred bottle at the top, a full-width headline and subhead block below it, and a closing row with the badges on the left and the CTA flush right, then the legal line.
